**Governance shell, shared row helper and Roadmap view (PR 1/5 of #882)**

Implemented lib/governance-model.mjs (GOVERNANCE_VIEWS sub-nav table, GOVERNANCE_PLACEHOLDERS, row() shared entry shape) and lib/roadmap-model.mjs (buildRoadmapModel: epics grouped by kind==='epic', children nested by parent, rule-zero unlinked bucket, parent-not-epic divergences surfaced per row, no timeline computed). view-model.mjs's PLACEHOLDERS.governance flipped to null: governance is a real mode with its own sub-nav/sub-router from this PR on. app.js/index.html/app.css wire the governance-nav mount and render the Roadmap view; the other four sub-views still say their own placeholder. Roadmap rows carry no sourceStamp (deviation from R882-1's row() reuse, matching lane-model.mjs's own map-view precedent: graph nodes have no natural per-row file/forge source). Counted diff 308 lines, full suite 5862/5862 (baseline 5852 + 10 new tests).
